🧬 Cepha CLI v2.0.54
  Powered by NetWasmMvc.SDK
  📂 ~
  🏪 Store: http://localhost:7700/
  ─────────────────────────

  Usage: cepha [command] [options]

  🟢 Standard  — Included with every Cepha CLI install

    new <name>                    Create a new Cepha MVC application
    new <name> --identity         Create with Identity authentication
    new <name> --identity-server  Create OAuth2/OIDC identity server
    new <name> --identity-topologyCreate server-only Identity with encrypted KV
    new <name> --identity-kv      Alias for --identity-topology
    new <name> --sovereign-identityAlias for --identity-topology
    new <name> --benchmark        Create a performance benchmark project
    scaffold <name>               Create native ASP.NET Core MVC + Identity app
    scaffold --convert            Convert verified native app to Cepha WASM
    test-drive [name]             Create → Convert → Build → Serve (all-in-one demo)
    convert                       Convert existing ASP.NET MVC project to Cepha
    topology                      Explain execution topology (Server/Browser/Mirror) + [CephaTopology]
    localization                  Scaffold the build-time localization pipeline (SPEC-0001 D3)
    dev                           Start development server (SPA + live reload)
    kit                           Start CephaKit backend server
    publish                       Build and publish for production (local folder)
    deploy verify <url>           Verify deployed Cepha/WASM host health and headers
    info                          Show current project information
    wasi                          Inspect WASI capabilities of dotnet.wasm
    benchmark                     Run high-load UI performance tests
    native-app                    Convert Cepha MVC → native Android/Windows app  💎
    native-app --build            Convert and build Android APK  💎
    alpha create <name>           Create a new Alpha App (.cph) for browser WASM
    alpha build <dir>             Build .cph package from Alpha app dire
[truncated]
